manifest.name: dsh-sidebar-balance
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: shows the signed-in account balance at the sidebar foot.
manifest.author: Qliphoth11

readme.text:
English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**See your balance without opening Settings → Account.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin that puts your signed-in
DeepSeek account balance right at the sidebar foot, reading the same data as the Account page. It follows
the theme and the UI language, refreshes on click and on sign-in changes, and reports nothing anywhere.

- A balance pill in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot, directly above the account/settings row.
- Reads the account through the shipped `account` Remote namespace (`getBalance`, plus the `watch`
  stream for sign-in changes), i.e. the same data the Account settings page shows. No credentials are
  copied, cached, or stored.
- Refreshes on mount, when the account signs in or out (account snapshot stream), when the pill is
  clicked, and when the window becomes visible again (30 s throttle). It never polls.
- Currency formatting follows the active UI language: two decimals and digit grouping, narrow currency
  symbols (`¥` / `$`), amounts summed in whole cents.
- The tooltip lists every currency wallet and any positive bonus credit, plus a refresh hint.
- Hides itself while signed out. When the sidebar is collapsed to the 56 px rail, the same reading
  moves to the composer status row as a compact pill beside the turn and token stats.

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (Desktop app or browser). Built and verified against `0.2.1-rc.5`.
- A signed-in DeepSeek account (Settings → Account). API-key-only setups have no Platform balance to show.

This repository is a Cordis bundle. The bundle patch inserts one Host row; the `dsh.client` declaration in
`package.json` publishes `client.js` to the browser.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Qliphoth11/sidebar-balance.git
```

Then ask the Harness agent to install the bundle directory, absolute path:

> Install the bundle at `/absolute/path/to/sidebar-balance`

The agent runs the plugin manager's `install_bundle` with that path as the target. Installation links the
checkout, so later edits apply after a page reload.

If your Harness accepts a pnpm spec for bundles, ask the agent to install:

> `github:Qliphoth11/sidebar-balance`

Otherwise use the clone + local path route above.

Ask the agent to remove the `dsh-sidebar-balance` bundle, or disable **Sidebar Balance** in
Settings → Plugins.

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `sidebar-balance` Loader row. |
| `index.js` | Host half: an empty `apply()`. Its only job is to give the bundle a Loader row whose `dsh.client` declaration publishes the browser module. |
| `client.js` | Client half: declares `inject: ['slots', 'locale', 'remote', 'remote.account']`, registers one entry in `sidebar.footer.action`, keeps the chip state in a tiny external store exposed to React through the slot's `hooks` injection, and mirrors the account snapshot stream via `ctx.remote.$stream`. |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager display metadata (title/description) for `en` and `zh`. |
| `icon.svg` | Original plugin artwork. |

Styling uses only `--dsw-*` theme tokens, so the pill follows the host palette and light/dark themes.
Visible text is routed through the Client locale service (`sidebar.balance` namespace, `en` + `zh`).

- The plugin relies on the shipped slot id `sidebar.footer.action` and the `account` Remote namespace
  (`getBalance`, `watch`). A Harness release that renames or removes them needs a plugin update.
- The collapsed sidebar (56 px rail) allocates a single 36 px icon cell at the foot, so the balance
  moves to the composer status row there instead; both places share one store, so a refresh in either
  updates both.
- The amount is the DeepSeek Platform account wallet (recharge funds plus separate bonus wallets). It is
  not a spend counter for third-party providers or API keys.
- No telemetry, no network requests of its own: every read goes through the Host account service.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

```sh
npm run check   # node --check on both halves
```

A client plugin hot-reloads while the Web dev watcher (`pnpm run dev:web`) runs from a source checkout;
on an installed app, reload the page after changing `client.js`.
